key_insight: Landscape intervals encode rank-function changes in all parameter directions, yielding two stable multiparameter persistence landscape invariants.
engineering_relevance: These invariants offer vector-space representations of multiscale topology for use in standard machine learning pipelines.
method: Represent directional rank-function changes geometrically using landscape intervals.
Construct two invariants that recover one-parameter landscapes and yield Vipond’s multiparameter landscapes.
Prove exact identities with erosion distances and stability bounds, and develop numerical extraction methods.
evidence_signal: The numerical framework is illustrated on surface mesh and medical image data; the abstract reports no quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: Recovery of the full invariants from finite module information is established only for a specified class of modules.
paper_title: Landscape Intervals: A Geometric Framework for Multiparameter Persistence Landscapes
